ambiguities.description: The authoritative Community unresolved collection contains 29 reservations and no active feature is scientifically execution-ready.
COMMUNITY-DECISION-001 requires an external authoritative invariant definition before scientific evaluation.
The feature has a registered IR, a candidate IR, and a supplemental semantic candidate IR. The supplemental artifact is historical evidence and is not promoted to canonical status.
Algorithm artifacts list total step sequences, but only validation and preservation before observable success or rejection are source-backed requirements.
Ownership, layout, allocation, concurrency, lifetime, aliasing, copying, moving, and error transport are not scientifically prescribed.

All packages expose a similar structural specification gate, but feature-specific opaque boundaries, blocker behavior, source multiplicity, and dependency classification make immediate shared-contract promotion unsafe.

Scientific execution for feature 006 uses COMMUNITY_ERR_UNRESOLVED_SCIENTIFIC_SEMANTICS with a visible blocker, while the other active features use COMMUNITY_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_EXECUTION_REQUEST. This difference is authoritative and intentionally preserved.

The authoritative inventory registry/domain-finalization/community/feature-status.yaml declares summary.active_features as 8 and contains exactly eight feature entries, but it has no root feature_count field. The protected progressive validator requires inventory.feature_count to equal the feature-list length, causing CI to fail with authoritative inventory feature count mismatch for domain community.
ambiguities.required_external_resolution: Align the protected validator with the existing inventory shape or add the missing root feature_count through a separately authorized source-governance change.
